threads.title: Does anyone know how much the pay is at continental European schools like IESE and Catolica Lisbon?

posts.body: Does anyone know how much the pay is at continental European schools like IESE and Catolica Lisbon?
Catolica Lisbon is 80K euros, I think. You have some tax advantages as well. IESE pays a lot more, something like 150K euros. There may also be tax advantages in Spaind
Thank you!

IESE used to be close to 100k, now maybe more. There is indeed a tax advantage. Other schools - it really depends. Majority would be around 100-120k range. Dutch schools, closer to 70-80. INSEAD and LBS pay US salary (but taxes are obviously higher). French schools like NEOMA, I don't know. I would guess 80-100k
IESE pays 120-130k for rookies

For rookies, IESE pays 130k + 15k publication bonus if you publish enough (guaranteed for the first 3 years). Catolica pays 80k + 12k bonus per publication. Both Portugal and Spain have tax advantages.
Spain tax advantages have a time limit. Read about the Beckham law. Also, there are very heavy taxes on savings, investments, etc
Yeh, but good tapas and wine, you can't have it all!
Tapas are for tourists. Spanish people may eat one while drinking a caña. There is real Spanish food!
What do other European schools pay nowadays? Any recent info?
Which schools? Other comments mentioned Netherlands, INSEAD/LBS. UCL/Imperial pay 140K GBP (no tax advantages in the UK). The rest pay very well for European standards, but nothing crazy
What does NEOMA pay or other french schools?
